contract: Exact v1 pattern-step maps and pure per-request action settlement; no runtime or payload-schema validation.
limits: Only v1 closed kind sets and 1..64 unique actions per request; no Run-wide identity registry.
Caller owns serialization, tracker persistence, truthful schemas, verified identity, recorded time, payload validation and secret exclusion.
No authentication, authorization, input log, timers, budget enforcement, execution, automatic retries or durability guarantee.

grounding.claim: The production correlation decision returns late for a settled action for all Boolean known/late/compatible operands; excludes map validation, lookup and persistence.
The pinned Cure compiler checks the pure correlation decision and selected law.
Named v1 round-trip, redaction, bounds, duplicate/late/independent settlement, person-answer, source audit and checked-example scenarios pass; finite tests, not a durability proof.
Relies on pinned Cure compilation, Boolean decisions and equality checking; compiler soundness is not locally proved.
The host supplies truthful schemas, recorded time, verified principal, Run-wide unique identities and secret-free validated payloads; callers serialize and preserve trackers.

telemetry.contract: Pure validation and settlement emit no observations; callers own instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic data operands and a fixed v1 bound; no ambient settings or selectable policy.

control.contract: No independent process, lifecycle or operational commands.
